lernapps.github.io.message:
feat(home): drop the quick filters; the foundation makes ideas quick to build

## Intent

The links by grade and subject under the example apps got in the way more than they helped; the catalogue has its own filter. The makers' section should end on why the foundation helps.

## Key changes

- The quick filters under the examples are gone.
- "Ein solides Fundament für Macher" ends with "So wird es einfach und schnell, eigene Ideen umzusetzen."

## Dependencies and side effects

- The catalogue now invites people who find nothing to build an app (apps 0a784a7).

apps.message:
feat(find): "Nichts gefunden? Hilf dir selbst und bau eine App"

## Intent

Where the catalogue has nothing that fits, it should invite people to build the app themselves, since the tooling makes that easy. It takes the place of the quick filters that the home page dropped.

## Key changes

- Under the catalogue's results, always visible and so also when nothing fits: "Nichts gefunden? Hilf dir selbst und bau eine App. Mit unserem Tooling ist es ganz einfach.", with a button to /apps/build/.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The home page drops its quick filters in the same step (lernapps.github.io 459eff1).
